experiments.hypothesis: Left-hand search priors in MajorLineClassifier are horizontally mirrored compared to right-hand priors, causing severe recall degradation on left palms.
experiments.change: Added handedness propagation to palm object in PalmVisionEngine and implemented resolvePriors in MajorLineClassifier with sector reflection (x -> 1-x) and Apollo corridor adjustment.

experiments.hypothesis: PalmUsabilityValidator clips top edge based on bounding box, incorrectly penalizing close-ups where fingertips graze the border but the MCP palm creases are completely intact.
experiments.change: Refined top clipping check to evaluate middle MCP joint landmark (landmark 9) y-coordinate against top margin rather than bounding box top.

experiments.hypothesis: Rigid transverse span threshold (dx < 0.18) drops genuine Head/Heart segments exhibiting subtle curvature or partial fragmentation.
experiments.change: Calibrated search priors sector ranges and relaxed transverse span threshold from 0.18 to 0.12, maintaining curvature and angle guards.

acceptedChanges: Left-hand search prior mirroring (resolvePriors with handedness reflection)
MCP-aware top-clipping usability validation in PalmUsabilityValidator
Transverse crease span calibration (dx < 0.12 with sector bounds)
rejectedChanges: Global lowering of furrow contrast verification thresholds (rejected: increased false positives on micro-wrinkles)
Arbitrary curve extension / polynomial extrapolation beyond visible crease endpoints (rejected: violates P15 anti-fabrication mandate)
